g.text: Feature Flag Schema: One Small Control Plane, One High-Volume Log
flags -> targeting_rules is the config an admin edits; flags -> evaluation_events is write-heavy analytics, kept separate.
targeting_rules is read on every config PUBLISH (rare) to build the immutable
snapshot -- never read live during the 200M/sec evaluation path itself.
evaluation_events is written far more than read: no index beyond the day-partition key.
This is one of the few schemas in this guide that barely needs to scale: thousands
of flags, a few edits/day. Only evaluation_events grows fast -- and it belongs in a
separate analytics store, not the config database, the moment it becomes hot.
